definitions.direction: later if auc_position > 0.5 (included records later in the data file than excluded records), earlier if < 0.5
definitions.tie_group: records of one review with identical stored Jev probability (stored to two decimals)
definitions.within_tie_concordance: share of (included, excluded) pairs in the same tie group in which the included record comes first in the data file; 0.5 = no advantage
definitions.wss95_diff: WSS@95 with ties in data-file order (stable sort) minus mean WSS@95 over random tie-break seeds 0-9
definitions.contribution: wss95_diff / number of reviews of the collection (sums to the macro difference)
